claims.text: The headquarters of the United Nations is in New York City.
The UN headquarters is not in Geneva, Paris or Washington, DC.
In December 1946, John D. Rockefeller Jr. donated 8.5 million US dollars to buy the East River site for the UN headquarters.
Geneva was the seat of the League of Nations and is home to the United Nations Office at Geneva, the UN's main European office.
